stories.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026: Is your enterprise ready to let AI agents act?
stories.summary: Microsoft demonstrated an IT agent capable of diagnosing device issues and changing access rights during a lab session at Ignite 2026. While the company showcased how quickly teams can build these tools, the demo left a lingering question about whether businesses should actually grant them such control.

stories.title: Accenture pushes deeper into AI compliance tools
stories.summary: Accenture is expanding its regulatory data platforms to connect compliance feeds with enterprise risk systems, aiming for scalable revenue. Despite the push, the company's share price has faced short-term pressure, with a 10.26 percent decline over the last week. Recent momentum is trailing medium-term performance.

stories.title: ASIC investigates misconduct allegations at consulting firms
stories.summary: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission is investigating 35 allegations of serious misconduct following a review of major audit firms. The regulator previously uncovered 558 complaints after using compulsory powers to access internal records at KPMG, EY, Deloitte, and PwC. The investigation remains ongoing.

stories.title: McKinsey survey: 60% of companies plan to boost AI spending
stories.summary: According to McKinsey, 60 percent of organizations expect to increase AI investments next year. However, 20 percent of respondents report that rising operating costs, including token usage, are already limiting their current adoption. Only 37 percent of firms currently see any impact on their earnings.

Bain survey finds 77% of finance leaders report unexpected AI costs
stories.summary: A Bain & Company survey of 150 finance leaders found that 77 percent have encountered unexpected costs from agentic AI. While nearly all expect spending to rise over the next two years, only 17 percent of executives are highly concerned about controlling those expenses.

Oliver Wyman to acquire financial consultancy Synpulse
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to acquire Synpulse, a technology and AI platform company serving financial institutions. The Zurich-based firm employs 1,200 professionals across 20 locations. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, though the companies did not disclose the financial terms of the deal.

stories.title: Consultants reap public sector boom thanks to AI and cyber security - Financial Times
Global luxury market remains stable at $1.65 trillion
stories.summary: Bain & Company reports that global luxury spending will reach $1.65 trillion in 2026, marking a 16 to 22 percent increase since 2019. Growth is driven by experiences and personal goods, though spending patterns vary significantly by region as European consumers shift budgets toward travel and hospitality.

stories.title: India leads APAC in workplace AI adoption
stories.summary: A Boston Consulting Group report states that 96 percent of employees in India use AI tools regularly, the highest rate among nine Asia-Pacific markets. These workers report saving an average of 15 hours per week, with 61 percent using that time for additional strategic tasks.

stories.title: 96% Of Indian Employees Use AI At Work Regularly, Highest In APAC: BCG - BW Businessworld
stories.summary: As many as 96 per cent of employees in India use artificial intelligence (AI) tools daily or two to three times a week, the highest among nine Asia-Pacific (APAC) markets, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG). The findings from BCG's second annual APAC AI at Work survey

stories.title: India Tops Asia-Pacific In Workplace AI Adoption, BCG Report Reveals A Major Productivity Leap
stories.summary: Mumbai: India has emerged as the leader in workplace artificial intelligence (AI) adoption across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, with 96% of employees using AI regularly, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG). The findings highlight India's rapidly evolving digital workplace, where AI-powered tools are transforming productivity, operational efficiency

stories.title: Market share no longer guarantees visibility in AI shopping
stories.summary: Bain & Company reports that AI is upending traditional retail funnels as consumers increasingly rely on agents for recommendations. The firm warns that market share alone no longer guarantees visibility in AI search answers, forcing retailers to compete for traffic through third-party and personal AI assistants.

stories.title: BCG and CII target $100 billion in textile exports by 2031
stories.summary: A report by Boston Consulting Group and the Confederation of Indian Industry suggests India could reach $100 billion in textile exports by 2031. Achieving this target requires annual growth of over 20 percent, supported by improvements in factory productivity and a focus on finished garment manufacturing.

stories.title: Study links heavy AI use to worker mental fatigue
stories.summary: Researchers from Boston Consulting Group and UC Riverside have coined the term brain fry to describe severe mental fatigue among heavy AI users. The study, featured in the Harvard Business Review, found that 14 percent of U.S. respondents reported exhaustion from the effort of reviewing AI outputs.

stories.title: AI job postings rise 60% despite global hiring slowdown
stories.summary: Data from Bain's Aura platform shows a two-speed labor market where overall hiring is subdued but AI-related roles have increased by 60 percent globally. France and Brazil saw the steepest declines in total job postings, while India recorded a more moderate decrease of 5 percent.

stories.title: Hokuriku Bank backs Bain-linked bid for Hokuriku Electric Industry
stories.summary: Hokuriku Bank has agreed to tender its 3.84% stake in Hokuriku Electric Industry into the BCJ-116 take-private offer. The bank joins four other holders who previously signed agreements to support the Bain Capital-linked bid. The offer is priced at 4,180 yen per share.

stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions acquires Vikramshila Power Transmission
stories.summary: Adani Energy Solutions has acquired the entire equity of Vikramshila Power Transmission from REC Power Development and Consultancy. The cash-based transaction gives Adani control of the project-specific entity, which was formed to manage a power transmission scheme in Bihar. The infrastructure is intended to evacuate electricity.

stories.title: Avanade acquires Spanish consultancy Plain Concepts
stories.summary: Avanade has agreed to acquire Plain Concepts, a Spanish consultancy specializing in artificial intelligence and Microsoft technologies. The deal adds 600 specialists to Avanade's mid-market business and expands its footprint in Spain and Portugal. The acquisition is intended to help clients modernize technology and accelerate AI adoption.

stories.title: Avanade acquires 600-person Spanish technology consultancy Plain Concepts
stories.summary: Avanade has agreed to acquire Plain Concepts, a Spanish consultancy specializing in artificial intelligence and Microsoft technologies. The acquisition aims to strengthen Avanade's presence in Spain and Portugal. Founded as a joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade provides services spanning cloud computing, AI, and cybersecurity.

stories.title: Nexus Select Trust acquires Kolkata's Diamond Plaza Mall
stories.summary: Blackstone-backed Nexus Select Trust has acquired the 396,609-square-foot Diamond Plaza Mall in North Kolkata for 355 crore rupees. The deal was concluded by real estate consultancy Anarock. The trust says the mall marks a great entry point for its retail portfolio in eastern India.

McKinsey report estimates $400 billion cost for steel capacity target
stories.summary: India will need to invest up to 400 billion dollars over two decades to reach a steel capacity target of 600 million metric tonnes by 2047, according to McKinsey. Current capacity is 233 million metric tonnes. Planned projects cover only a fraction of the required expansion.

stories.title: Aluminium body seeks import duty hike
stories.summary: The Aluminium Association of India has requested higher import duties and mandatory quality standards for scrap to protect a 4 trillion rupee investment pipeline. The industry body also asked the government to support the creation of downstream aluminium parks to safeguard proposed capital projects.

stories.title: Steel demand projected to reach 280 million tonnes by 2035
stories.summary: India's steel demand is projected to hit 280 million metric tonnes annually by 2035, according to a McKinsey report. The sector currently contributes 2 percent of GDP and supports 2.8 million jobs. Reaching the 2047 capacity target may require up to 400 billion dollars in investment.

stories.title: Government touts PLI schemes as global growth driver
stories.summary: India's production-linked incentive schemes have been implemented across 14 sectors to attract investment and expand manufacturing. Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the policy as a global bright spot for growth. The next phase of the program focuses on deeper localization and innovation in supply chains.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector highlighted in self-reliance push
stories.summary: India's manufacturing sector has expanded through initiatives including the Production Linked Incentive scheme, PM GatiShakti, and the National Logistics Policy. The government claims these programs have positioned the nation as a global hub for defense, pharmaceuticals, and electronics as it celebrates its 80th Independence Day.

stories.title: Textile exports remain stagnant at $37 billion
stories.summary: India's textile and apparel exports have remained at 37 billion dollars for a decade, according to a CII and BCG report. To reach a 100 billion dollar target by 2031, the industry requires integrated manufacturing clusters. India currently holds less than 1 percent of high-growth garment categories.

stories.title: Textile industry targets $350 billion valuation by 2031
stories.summary: The Indian textile and apparel industry must grow by 10 percent annually to reach a 350 billion dollar valuation by 2031, according to a BCG-CII report. Exports must grow by 20 percent annually to hit a 100 billion dollar goal. The sector currently employs 45 million people.

Auto PLI scheme hits investment targets but lags in sales
stories.summary: NITI Aayog reports that the automobile production-linked incentive scheme has reached 104 percent of its investment target. However, incremental sales remain at 23 percent and employment at 46 percent. The industry has cited strict localization norms and compliance hurdles as factors affecting the program's performance.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Should a platform show all consumers all products, or at least those they like most? Or could it raise consumer surplus by mismatching some consumers: showing them only less-preferred products or even excluding them from trade?. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Linear Demand Systems are Consistent with Discrete Choice
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aggregate linear demand systems can be micro-founded by a population of heterogeneous consumers making discrete choices. They can also be extended to incorporate income effects. I prove these results and show how to structurally estimate this. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Neighbourhood flood damage amplifies mortgage default cascades
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Floods threaten mortgage repayment by damaging homes, disrupting incomes, and worsening conditions in surrounding neighbourhoods. However, it remains unclear how these neighbourhood effects turn local damage into systemic mortgage distress, as Europe's housing crisis leaves households. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Given the high cost of grid-scale batteries, other energy storage approaches are needed for developing and low-income regions. Elevated volumes of water are often more economically feasible energy storage options than batteries in these contexts. This. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Place-Based Policy from Space: Evidence from Italy's Inner Areas
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper evaluates a place-based policy, Italy's National Strategy for Inner Areas (SNAI), using satellite nighttime lights. Targeting structurally fragile and peripheral municipalities, SNAI invests in essential services and economic activities. Staggered difference-in-differences compares 941 funded. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
